content.coverIntro: Van Dijk Techniek is growing, and the sales organisation is growing with it - eight field sales reps, each with their own region and their own way of keeping a pipeline. This proposal focuses on a concrete, recognisable problem: the Monday-morning overview that takes Marloes four hours every Friday to put together by hand, and that is already out of date by Monday.
content.situation: Every rep keeps their own Excel sheet with open quotes, expected value and expected closing date. Every Friday afternoon Marloes manually copies these together into an overarching overview - a job of about four hours a week. Because nobody updates over the weekend and there have already been new conversations by Monday, the overview is often already outdated during the weekly management meeting on Monday at 9 o'clock. There is also no reliable view of where deals actually get stuck: lost deals only become visible when a rep marks them manually, and that does not always happen. Exact Online is used exclusively for invoicing, not as a CRM.
goals: Have an up-to-date pipeline overview without manual copying, ready every Monday morning for the management meeting
Gain visibility of open value per stage, per rep and per region
Be better able to course-correct on underperforming regions or reps against target
Achieve this without starting a full CRM project yet - the organisation is not ready for that
content.approach: We build a Power BI dashboard that automatically merges the existing Excel sheets of the eight reps (submitted via the existing shared SharePoint folder) into an up-to-date pipeline overview. Reps keep working the way they are used to - nothing changes in their sheet or way of working. The dashboard shows open pipeline per stage, revenue against target, and performance per region and per rep, so Marloes can go into the meeting every Monday with current figures and no manual work.
scopeDeliverables: Connection that automatically reads the eight rep sheets from the shared SharePoint folder
Power BI dashboard with pipeline per stage, revenue vs. target, and an overview per region and per rep
Weekly automatic refresh, available for the Monday-morning meeting
Short guide for Marloes on how the reps should submit their sheet so the connection keeps working

phases.name: Week 1: scoping and data connection
phases.description: Inventory the eight sheets, align columns to a shared format, and set up the connection to the SharePoint folder.

phases.name: Week 2-3: build dashboard
phases.description: Build the Power BI dashboard with pipeline per stage, revenue vs. target and the view per region/rep, in the Datavance house style.

phases.name: Week 4: test and deliver
phases.description: Run one cycle with real data from the reps, adjust based on feedback from Marloes, and deliver in time for the next Monday meeting.

content.investment: This project is scoped as one clearly defined problem - the pipeline overview - at a fixed price. We will confirm the exact investment after a short scoping call in which we go through the eight sheets together.
content.nextSteps: Approval of this proposal, followed by a short scoping call (about 30 minutes) to go through the sheets and the desired format. After that we start straight away in week 1.
